title: Belgium Caught Between Stagnation and Austerity · 02 Sep
keywords: Belgium economy, Belgian inflation, austerity Belgium, Belgian budget 2029, eurozone inflation, GDP stagnation, Belgian fiscal policy, household purchasing power, wage indexation, European Union fiscal consolidation
notes: Belgium's economy flatlined in the second quarter of 2026 while inflation climbed to 4.2 percent in August, well above the eurozone average of 3.3 percent. The federal government is pressing ahead with a plan to cut roughly ten billion euros in spending by 2029, arguing that fiscal discipline is unavoidable. Critics warn that imposing austerity on an already stagnant economy risks making a difficult situation significantly worse for ordinary Belgians.
